---
title: "Publications" 
subtitle: "Research output"
description: |
  This is home for my research publications, each linked with<br>
  accompanying preprints, posters, and/or news pieces.
listing:
  - id: papers
    contents:
      - "**/index.qmd"
      - "**/index.markdown"
      - "**/index.md"
    sort: "date desc"
    type: default
    categories: true
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [title, author, categories, date, description]
    image-align: left
  # data only: each paper's `links:` for the buttons added by publications.js
  - id: paper-links
    contents:
      - "**/index.qmd"
    template: ../_partials/pub-links.ejs
    fields: [path, links]
    page-size: 1000
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
math: false
bibliography: publications.bib
body-classes: zl-index zl-pubs
comments: false
include-after-body:
  text: <script src="/assets/js/publications.js"></script>
---

::: {#papers}
:::

::: {#paper-links .zl-hidden}
:::
